headline: Session done — band held, strides clean, booked ~68 vs 60 planned
summary: Milan 62min easy + 8x20s strides, exactly as written. Average HR 155bpm — above the 146-152 target band (note: Sun 18 ran only 136bpm for comparison, so today's effort was clearly on the higher side of Z2, not under), with the interval summary showing most of the steady work around 149-155bpm and one segment up at 166. Cadence 84, RPE 5/feel 2 — a bit harder than an easy pre-travel shakeout should feel. Strides got in (8x20s, HR climbing into 166+ territory, consistent with 170-182 target zone intent). Load booked 68 vs 60 estimated, in line with the known 20-25% undercount tendency for strides-type sessions, so no red flag there — but combined with RPE 5 this wasn't the "light and easy" session the notes called for before a 21:45 flight.
flags: HR ran ~5-10bpm above the 146-152 band most of the main set — worth checking if that was pacing, heat, or incomplete warm-up before relying on this as a clean Z2 reference.
No knee/ITB signal reported — flat Milan course, non-issue today.
Wk6 is already running a pattern of easy days overshooting intended intensity while weekend quality has been the priority; watch that this doesn't compound into Wednesday's 3x14min session fatigue.
suggestedChange: None required — flag the HR drift to Alberto for awareness, but no plan change needed given travel day tomorrow and built-in recovery from the bike spin.
